description: This file contains the UtilProperties class, a utility class for managing application and locale-specific properties files, including cache management, resource bundle handling, and support for XML-based properties formats. It provides methods for retrieving, comparing, and setting property values, as well as for resource resolution and XML parsing.

classes.name: UtilResourceBundle
classes.description: A custom ResourceBundle extension for caching and supporting XML property formats with methods to load bundles based on resource name and locale.

classes.name: ExtendedProperties
classes.description: An extension of java.util.Properties to support loading from XML and custom XML property formats, with constructors to initialize from URLs and locale.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Compares the specified property value with a given string for equality.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Compares the specified property value with a given string for equality ignoring case.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property from a specified resource.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Creates a Properties instance from a given filename.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves a URL for a properties resource, considering locale and resource protocol.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts an XML InputStream into a Properties object, supporting both Java and OFBiz-specific XML formats.
